msg: Good afternoon. I am from Germany and I hold an Open Water certification, although I have not dived for three years. I am staying in Getsemaní and I would like to dive next Wednesday. My flight home leaves on Thursday at 22:00. Is this possible, and what would you recommend?
reply:

Good afternoon! Since you’re certified and haven’t dived for three years, the recommended option is a **refresher**. After it, you need to wait at least **18 hours from your last dive** before flying. If your last dive is during the daytime on Wednesday, you can fly from **7:00 a.m. Thursday**, so your 22:00 flight meets that interval.

It includes one dive and gear. The boat leaves Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m.

The booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before, so the online booking window for Wednesday has already closed.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required before the trip; if you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to ask about arranging it?

msg: Good, thank you. Two last questions: do you pick me up in Getsemaní or how do I reach the dock, and do I have to bring my certification card or fill in any forms for these two days?
reply:
There’s no hotel pick-up in Getsemaní. Please make your own way to **Muelle de la Bodeguita** for the **8:00 a.m.** departure; it’s about five minutes from the historic center. Ground transportation to the dock isn’t included. [Here’s the location](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Muelle+de+la+Bodeguita/@10.4199447,-75.5537609,828m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x8ef62f753729822d:0x1bbcdd8224d0eaaf!8m2!3d10.4199447!4d-75.551186!16s%2Fg%2F113gzkckf?entry=ttu)

Please bring your **certification card** for the Wednesday dives. You can show it on the day or send a photo beforehand.

For the forms:
- **Refresher on Tuesday:** complete the course medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol
- **Wednesday dives:** complete the certified-diver liability waiver: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol
- **Both days:** complete the insurance form sent in your booking confirmation email. If you haven’t received it, the confirmation email will remind you.

The forms are in Spanish.

You'll also need:
• There is no theory to do beforehand: it is done there, on the day, with the instructor.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

For Tuesday’s refresher, use the **course medical form** instead of the certified-diver waiver: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. There’s no theory to do beforehand; the instructor covers it on the day. Would you like help with anything else for your two days?
